description: IntAct interactome audit of Mdh2: are its recorded partners quality-control machinery or nuclear envelope/NPC components
code:
import requests, re, json
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

url="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/Tools/webservices/psicquic/intact/webservices/current/search/query/P22133"
r=requests.get(url, params={"format":"tab25","maxResults":"1000"},
               headers={"User-Agent":"curation-agent/1.0"}, timeout=120)
print("IntAct PSICQUIC status:", r.status_code, "bytes:", len(r.text))
rows=[l.split("\t") for l in r.text.strip().split("\n") if l.strip()]
print("raw interaction lines:", len(rows))

def names(field):
    return re.findall(r"uniprotkb:([A-Za-z0-9_\-]+)\(gene name\)", field)

partners={}
for row in rows:
    if len(row)<15: continue
    a,b=row[0],row[1]
    gA=names(row[4]); gB=names(row[5])
    idA=a.split(":")[-1]; idB=b.split(":")[-1]
    for pid,gn,other in [(idA,gA,idB),(idB,gB,idA)]:
        if pid!="P22133":
            g=gn[0] if gn else pid
            partners.setdefault(g,set()).add(row[13] if len(row)>13 else "")
print("\nDistinct physical partners of Mdh2 in IntAct:", len(partners))
plist=sorted(partners)
print(plist)

# classify partners against the two competing models
QC = {"BTN2","HSP42","HSP104","CMR1","SIS1","SSA1","SSA2","SSB1","SSB2","HSP82","HSC82","CCT2","CCT3","CCT4","CCT5","CCT6","CCT7","CCT8","TCP1","APJ1","YDJ1","STI1","HSP26","HSP78","UBC1","UBC4","UBC5","RPN1","RPT1","PRE1","CDC48","UBR1","GID1","GID2","GID4","GID5","GID7","GID8","GID9","VID24","VID28","VID30","RMD5","FYV10","UBP14"}
NE = {"NUP49","NUP57","NUP100","NUP116","NUP133","NUP159","NUP145","NUP170","NUP188","NUP192","NSP1","POM152","POM34","NDC1","MLP1","MLP2","HEH1","HEH2","SRC1","ESC1","NIC96","SEH1","SEC13","KAP95","KAP60","SRP1","CSE1","MSN5","NTF2","HMG1","HMG2","MPS3","NDJ1"}
cls={}
for g in plist:
    cls[g] = "chaperone / ubiquitin-proteasome / GID" if g.upper() in QC else ("nuclear envelope or NPC" if g.upper() in NE else "other")
cnt=pd.Series(cls).value_counts()
print("\n=== Partner classification ===")
print(cnt.to_string())
print("\nQC-machinery partners found:", sorted([g for g in plist if cls[g].startswith("chaperone")]))
print("Nuclear envelope / NPC partners found:", sorted([g for g in plist if cls[g].startswith("nuclear")]))

pd.DataFrame({"partner":plist,"class":[cls[g] for g in plist]}).to_csv("mdh2_intact_partners.csv",index=False)
print("\nsaved mdh2_intact_partners.csv")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,4.4))
order=["chaperone / ubiquitin-proteasome / GID","nuclear envelope or NPC","other"]
vals=[cnt.get(o,0) for o in order]
ax.bar(order,vals,color=["#4C78A8","#E45756","#BAB0AC"])
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax.text(i,v+0.3,str(v),ha="center",fontweight="bold")
ax.set_ylabel("number of distinct IntAct partners of Mdh2")
ax.set_xticklabels(order,fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_title(f"Mdh2 physical interactome in IntAct (n={len(plist)} partners):\nno nuclear envelope or nuclear pore partner recorded",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
